extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners and patent applicants/agents preparing or responding about patent drawings
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for determining the completeness and consistency of patent drawings in a utility or plant application, including proper use of reference characters, required corrections, and procedural requirements for replacement/new drawing sheets under 37 CFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures correctly described in the brief description of the several views
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner should ensure that the figures are correctly described in the brief description of the several views of the drawing section of the specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check that each figure corresponds to and is accurately described in the specification's brief description of the drawings; ensure consistency between figure content and the descriptive text. Also verify reference characters referred to in the description match the drawings and that there are no superfluous illustrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference characters properly applied (no duplicate use for different parts or modifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that the reference characters are properly applied, and that no single reference character is used for two different parts or for a given part and a modification of such part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a single reference character is used for different parts or for a part and its modification, object under 37 CFR 1.84(p)(4) (see form paragraphs 6.22.02 and 6.22.03). Require corrected drawing sheets in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d). Examiner notes instruct identifying the offending reference characters/parts in the form paragraph brackets.

rubrics_metrics.name: No superfluous illustrations
rubrics_metrics.description: There should be no superfluous illustrations in the drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove any illustrations that do not contribute to a proper understanding of the disclosed invention. If drawings contain unnecessary figures, object and require corrected replacement sheets per 37 CFR 1.121(d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential structural details must be shown in the drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Any structural detail that is essential for a proper understanding of the disclosed invention should be shown in the drawing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Object under 37 CFR 1.83(a) when required details are missing (see form paragraph 6.22.01). Require corrected drawing sheets in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) to avoid abandonment. Examiner notes: identify missing structural details in bracketed text; do not hold objections in abeyance for utility/plant applications (see 37 CFR 1.85(a)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Different numbers must not refer to the same part
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings must not use different reference numbers to designate the same part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reference characters "[1]" and [2] are both used to designate [3], object under 37 CFR 1.84(p)(4) (form paragraph 6.22.02). Require corrected drawing sheets per 37 CFR 1.121(d). Examiner notes: specify which numbers refer to the same part and identify the part in the form paragraph brackets. May follow with form paragraph 6.27 to require marked-up annotated copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: A single reference number must not designate different parts
rubrics_metrics.description: A single reference character must not be used to designate two different parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reference character "[1]" has been used to designate both [2] and [3], object under 37 CFR 1.84(p)(4) (form paragraph 6.22.03). Require corrected drawing sheets per 37 CFR 1.121(d). Examiner notes: identify the number and the multiple parts in the bracketed fields; may also require marked-up annotated figures (form paragraph 6.27).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference numbers mentioned in the specification must appear in the drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: All reference sign(s) mentioned in the description must be included in the drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Object under 37 CFR 1.84(p)(5) when the drawings do not include reference sign(s) that are mentioned in the description (form paragraph 6.22.06). Require corrected drawing sheets in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) or allow deletion of the reference character(s) from the description as an alternative. Examiner note: specify the missing reference characters and where they first occur in the specification (page and line).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference numbers in drawings must be mentioned in the specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference character(s) that appear in the drawings must also be mentioned in the description/specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Object under 37 CFR 1.84(p)(5) when drawings include reference characters not mentioned in the description (form paragraph 6.22.07). Require corrected drawing sheets per 37 CFR 1.121(d), or require amendment to the specification to add the reference character(s) in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(b). Examiner note: identify the reference characters and the figure in which they occur; may follow with form paragraph 6.27 to request marked-up annotated figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for submitting corrected, replacement, or new drawing sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Corrected drawing sheets must comply with 37 CFR 1.121(d) and must include all figures appearing on the immediate prior version of the sheet even if only one figure is amended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each drawing sheet submitted after filing must be labeled in the top margin as either "Replacement Sheet" or "New Sheet" per 37 CFR 1.121(d). Do not label an amended drawing figure as "amended." If canceling a drawing figure, remove the appropriate figure from the replacement sheet and renumber remaining figures as necessary; update the brief description of the several views of the drawings for consistency. Additional replacement sheets may be necessary to show renumbering. If changes are not accepted by the examiner, applicant will be notified of required corrective action in the next Office action and the objection will not be held in abeyance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objections to drawings in utility or plant applications are not held in abeyance
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise notified in an Office action, objections to the drawings in a utility or plant application will not be held in abeyance, and a request to hold objections to the drawings in abeyance will not be considered a bona fide attempt to advance the application to final action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 37 CFR 1.85(a). Examiner should treat draw­ing objections as needing immediate corrective response (i.e., require corrected drawings or specification amendments) rather than allowing deferment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner may require marked-up annotated copies of amended figures
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner may require a marked up copy of the amended drawing figure(s) including annotations indicating the changes made in the corrected drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requirement is commonly invoked by following the drawing objection form paragraphs with form paragraph 6.27. Use such marked-up copies to verify that corrections address the objection.
